title: Vani's four potted plants
body: Vani believes that carbon dioxide is essential for photosynthesis. She takes four similar potted plants, each with sufficient water, and first keeps all of them in the dark for three days so that they lose any stored starch. She then places them under four conditions: plant (a) in sunlight with carbon dioxide available; plant (b) in sunlight inside a closed container with caustic soda, which absorbs carbon dioxide; plant (c) in the dark with carbon dioxide available; and plant (d) in the dark inside a closed container with caustic soda. After a few hours she plucks one leaf from each plant, decolourises it in alcohol and tests it with dilute iodine solution.
